cad_rules: Drive every Z level from the expressions in derived_levels.expressions; never type the evaluated numbers into the model.
glass_t changes only the levels in front of the panel (Z_GLASS_FRONT .. Z_TUBE_TOP); everything at Z >= Z_FORMEX_FRONT is frame v2 geometry.
Step wall (s 0.4 .. 2.9 from the glass edge) is one body from Z_SHEET_BACK to Z_STEPWALL_BACK in every case; union it with the lip, the flange plate and the land plate.

Level snap: if |Z_FLANGE_BACK - Z_LANDPLATE_BACK| < 0.5 (glass_t 1.1 gives 0.10), extend the flange back to Z_STEPWALL_BACK (flange 2.6) so no 0.1 mm step face is created; the stud tube top follows (Z_STEPWALL_BACK + tube_h).
At glass_t 1.1 the recess floor (Z_LAND) lies only 0.10 behind the flange front: keep both faces; they are separated by the step wall, not adjacent.
Lip, seat ring, corner pads, glass recess and pips are formed in the A (fixed) half; parting line on the flange outline in the flange-front plane; single pull Z, no slides.
Tape strips are straight (4 pieces) and end tape_margin before the corner pads F1-F4 (GF-2.0: there is nothing at F5-F8).
Fastener slots F1-F4 are stadiums slot_w x slot_l at the flange front, 0.5 deg draft (wider to the back), long axis = slot_axis (towards the glass centre).

GF-2.0: Tail pocket x 38.9 / 167.7, bottom face 147.70 (R1.5): bend-gap slot y 119.0 .. bend_y1 open front to back; behind the bridge a floor = land-plate back (to the step-wall back) and the flange plate (Z_FLOOR_LOW); bottom wall = outer wall, flush with the flange edge.

GF-1.1: fastener counterbores 7.4 x 9.0 stadium (slot + 1.0 per side) coaxial with each F1-F4 slot, floor 1.6 above Z_SHEET_BACK (in the pad), R0.3 floor round, 1 deg; the 5.4 x 7.0 slot continues below (GF-2.0: F1-F4 only).

GF-1.1: annular coring groove round every fastener tube from the back, r 6.2-7.5 at the tube top, 3.3 deep, R0.4 floor rounds, 1 deg; the M4 washer sits on the dia-12.4 seat, the M5 rivet backing washer (dia 15) does NOT bridge the groove when centred: its edge lands on the groove's outer edge (r 7.5) and it bears ~88 mm2 on the dia-12.4 seat inside the groove (97-107 off-centre).
GF-1.1: H6 corner cell: cell wall jogged to leave the tail wall 1.1 at Z_PCB, R2.5 corner arc into the boss; no solid fill (thick-section rule: inscribed sphere <= 5.0 everywhere).
GF-1.1: frame outlines are glass-rectangle offsets with corner R_frame + s (R_frame 6.0); the glass corner is R_glass 6.25 and the sheet cut-out corner R_cut 7.55.

GF-1.1 round 3 (moulding): the lip top, the lip faces, the seat ring, the pads (F1-F4 hard-stop faces) and the land are exclusion zones for gates, ejector marks and parting lines; vent witness on the lip top is allowed only if flush within 0.02 (toolmaker to propose); this supersedes 'vents at the lip top every ~50 mm' in the concept text (concept.md).

GF-2.0: one driving border (all four sides); glass_y1 = pw_y1 + border; g_bend drives the bridge pocket face (bend_y1 = panel_y1 + g_bend at Z_LAND); flange bottom = flange_y1_bottom (flush with the bottom wall).

GF-2.1: bridge = land plate + step wall + flange plate over the tail span; nose R bend_nose_R on the land-plate back x pocket face (B side), land_break 0.3 x 45 deg on the land x pocket face (A side); slot faces 1 deg; the bend-gap slot is the only through-opening at the bottom. Its shut-off A/B is NOT a flat face at Z_LAND: the parting runs on the bridge side at the top of the land break (y 122.235, Z_LAND + land_break = -10.12) and on the front side at the shelf corner (y 119.00, Z_SEAT -4.60), so it rises 5.52 over the 3.235 slot width.
